# Synthetic XHTTP links (task plan_2026_10_02_gatehouse_links_xhttp_hysteria2.md).
# Fake UUIDs and pubkeys; every host under example.com. Mirrors the real shapes
# StashVPN and Epsiquad hand out: TLS and Reality, a long path, host sometimes
# absent, `mode=auto`, `extra` as JSON and absent.
vless://11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111@xhttp-tls.example.com:443?type=xhttp&security=tls&sni=xhttp-tls.example.com&fp=chrome&alpn=h2&host=cdn.example.com&path=/x&mode=auto&extra=%7B%22xpaddingBytes%22%3A%22100-1000%22%7D#XHTTP%20TLS
vless://22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222@xhttp-reality.example.com:8443?type=xhttp&security=reality&pbk=PUBKEY_ONE&sid=ab12&sni=www.example.com&fp=firefox&mode=auto&path=/r&spx=%2F#XHTTP%20Reality
vless://33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333@split.example.com:80?type=splithttp&security=reality&pbk=PUBKEY_TWO&sid=cd34&sni=www.example.com&mode=auto#Split%20HTTP
